stem.text: A vibrating tuning fork is held above a glass cylinder filled to the top with water. The water level is steadily lowered. A loud sound is first heard when the water level is $83.5\,\text{cm}$ above the bench. The next loud sound is heard when the water level is $17.1\,\text{cm}$ above the bench.

stem.alt: Glass cylinder filled with water with a tuning fork held above it and a water outlet at its base, standing on a bench; dimensions 83.5 cm and 17.1 cm marked from the bench; the note NOT TO SCALE.

stem.text: The speed of sound in air is $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the frequency of the tuning fork?
